These two equal-area nonorthogonal terminal planes establish a unique acute bisector line, the largest eigenline of the sum of their unoriented direction outer products. Rust uses that intrinsic line and explicitly leaves roll as an axial gauge; Python picks the first equally ranked end plane. OpenCascade independently confirms the equal planar areas and terminal normals. frames::axial_tie_tests proves covariance under Z30/X30/X90 and invariance to support sign/order, while the regular tetrahedron control refuses an unresolved multidirection tie.
